reviews.review:
Going to be my first time writing something here I think.
The game's definitely got its charm, combat is tough unless you know what you're doing so expect to die a couple times until you learn how to conserve ammo and what weapon works best against each enemy. Here's a couple hints:
- best to adjust brightness to max, doesn't kill the atmosphere it's just so you can actually see things
- don't use medkits if you're just slightly hurt, instead use spray paint to mark the spot and come back if you really need it
- you can't outrun your enemies and they can see you through walls, so take them one by one as you see them
- make sure to check surroundings before confronting Hope (woman sitting on the ground) so you don't get sandwiched
- flamer is best used against slow centipedes as you can burn them before they reach you
- save pistol ammo for enemies that leap at you and the bosses.
- It's not a maze, every turn either leads to the exit or a dead end. You can find ammo and medkits at dead ends
the rest you'll have to figure out on you own.
I certainly had fun and recommend it to everyone who can deal with the visuals and isn't scared of a challenge. It's free and rather short so you're not losing much.
